audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Neeko wins Level 1 and Skill at Levels 4-5 and 6, while the prose in whys[0], whys[3] and whys[4] describes Ryze owning the early poke and Neeko owning 6. Packet chart is Ryze/Skill/Skill/Ryze/Neeko/Ryze/Ryze.
audit.why: 41.18% win rate and Overload's 5s cooldown resetting off W/E give Ryze the early poke war; Neeko's only true window is Pop Blossom at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 flipped in both layers to Ryze / Ryze / Neeko, matching the packet chart and the existing prose.
sources: kit: Ryze Q cd 5s with resets

audit.why: Level 6 Pop Blossom, Stormsurge, and Ryze's 2-item mana scaling are the real spikes and all four spikes[] entries name them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text called Rune Prison a flat 'point-blank root' and credited Shapesplitter with invisibility.
audit.why: Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and SLOWS; it only roots if Flux (E) is on the target. Neeko's W sends a directional clone and grants a third-attack move-speed proc — no invisibility is described in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux, so the lock is E-then-W; dodge the E and the W is only a slow. W is described as a clone, not invisibility.

audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is the punishable cooldown.
suspectNames flagged 'Use Shapesplitter' at wants.you[1]; Shapesplitter is Neeko's real W name — false positive.

edits.before: Open disguised as something harmless — the first Q trade lands while Ryze is still reading the wave.
edits.after: Overload resets off his other spells on a 5s base, so he pokes free while your Q is still single-target.

edits.before: Trade Q on his CS timings and hold E for the step-up. The disguise resets every bad position you take.
edits.after: He farms behind 1000-range Overload and taxes every step you take to CS; hold E for his 615-range step-up.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — your all-in is a setup puzzle: E root, walk in as a clone or minion, R the panic.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while disguised: land E first, then R — a 180s Realm Warp saves nobody.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux is on you — step up while his E is down; the W itself is a 9s slow.

edits.before: Track Ryze’s Rune Prison (Root): Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: it roots only through Spell Flux, so E-then-W is the lock — dodge the E and the W is just a slow.

edits.before: Your first window: bait his root with Shapesplitter invisibility, then Tangle-Barbs into Q re-bloom out-bursts a shieldless Ryze.
edits.after: Your first window at 3: clone-bait his Spell Flux, then Tangle-Barbs root into Q re-bloom out-bursts him before Overload resets.

edits.before: Use Shapesplitter (W) invisibility/clone to dodge his Q-E root combo and bait his W root
edits.after: Send the Shapesplitter (W) clone in to eat Spell Flux so his 615-range Rune Prison only slows
